name: Task Registry
description: Holds the set of configured task types loaded from config. Each task entry includes: name, description, input/output schema, system_prompt and prompt_template, evaluator type, match_fields, and confidence thresholds. Provides lookup by task name. Built as a frozen Pydantic v2 model containing a validated, immutable mapping of task names to TaskConfig objects. Immutable after startup (no hot-reload). Downstream components depend on the TaskRegistryProtocol for read-only access, enabling test doubles without inheritance. All validation (schema structure, template placeholders, match_fields cross-referencing, threshold ordering, duplicate names) happens at construction time and fails fast with clear messages.

types.name: EvaluatorType
types.description: Enum of supported evaluator types for task output evaluation. Implemented as Python StrEnum.

types.name: ConfidenceThresholds

fields.name: phase1_to_phase2_example_count
fields.description: Minimum number of validated training examples required before transitioning from Phase 1 (remote-only) to Phase 2 (coaching/shadow). Must be >= 1.

fields.name: phase2_to_phase3_correlation
fields.description: Minimum correlation score between local and remote outputs required to transition from Phase 2 to Phase 3 (local-primary). Must be in (0.0, 1.0].

fields.name: coaching_trigger
fields.description: Confidence score below which the system triggers a coaching/retraining cycle. Must be in (0.0, 1.0) and strictly less than phase2_to_phase3_correlation.

fields.name: emergency_threshold
fields.description: Confidence score below which the system raises an emergency alert and falls back to remote. Must be in [0.0, 1.0) and strictly less than coaching_trigger.

types.description: Confidence thresholds governing phase transitions and alerting for a task. Frozen Pydantic v2 BaseModel. Cross-field invariant: emergency_threshold < coaching_trigger < phase2_to_phase3_correlation <= 1.0, and phase1_to_phase2_example_count >= 1. All float thresholds are in [0.0, 1.0].

types.name: JsonSchemaDict
types.description: A dict representing a JSON Schema object. Must be a valid JSON Schema with at minimum a 'type' key. Used for input_schema and output_schema on TaskConfig. Runtime type is dict[str, any].

types.name: TaskConfig

fields.name: name
fields.description: Unique task identifier. Must be a non-empty snake_case string matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.

validators.error_message: Task name must be non-empty snake_case: lowercase letters, digits, and underscores, starting with a letter.
Task name must be between 1 and 128 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Human-readable description of what this task does.

validators.error_message: Task description must not be empty.

fields.name: input_schema
fields.description: JSON Schema defining the expected input structure for this task. Must have 'type': 'object' and a 'properties' key.

validators.expression: 'type' in value and value['type'] == 'object' and 'properties' in value
validators.error_message: input_schema must be a JSON Schema with type 'object' and a 'properties' key.

fields.name: output_schema
fields.description: JSON Schema defining the expected output structure for this task. Must have 'type': 'object' and a 'properties' key.

validators.expression: 'type' in value and value['type'] == 'object' and 'properties' in value
validators.error_message: output_schema must be a JSON Schema with type 'object' and a 'properties' key.

fields.name: system_prompt
fields.description: System prompt sent to the LLM for this task. Must be non-empty.

fields.name: prompt_template
fields.description: Python str.format-style template for constructing the user prompt. All placeholders (e.g. {field_name}) must correspond to keys in input_schema.properties. Must be non-empty.

fields.name: evaluator_type
fields.description: Which evaluator strategy to use when scoring local model outputs against remote reference outputs for this task.

fields.name: match_fields
fields.description: List of output field names used by the evaluator to compare outputs. Each field must be a key in output_schema.properties. Non-empty list of strings.

validators.error_message: match_fields must contain at least one field.

fields.name: confidence_thresholds
fields.description: Confidence thresholds controlling phase transitions and alerting for this task.

types.description: Full configuration for a single task type. Frozen Pydantic v2 BaseModel with extra='forbid'. Model validators ensure: (1) all match_fields reference keys present in output_schema properties, (2) all placeholders in prompt_template (Python str.format style, e.g. {field_name}) reference keys present in input_schema properties, (3) system_prompt is non-empty, (4) name is a non-empty lowercase_snake identifier.

types.name: TaskRegistry

fields.name: tasks
fields.description: Internal mapping from task name (str) to TaskConfig. Built from the validated task list at construction. Keys are task names, values are TaskConfig instances. This field is populated by the model_validator from the input task list and should not be set directly by callers.

types.description: Frozen Pydantic v2 BaseModel containing a validated, immutable mapping of task names to TaskConfig objects. Constructed from a list of TaskConfig objects (typically parsed from the 'tasks' key in apprentice.yaml by config_loader). A model_validator detects duplicate task names at construction time. After construction, the registry is fully immutable — no tasks can be added, removed, or modified. Exposes read-only lookup methods.

types.name: TaskRegistryProtocol
types.description: typing.Protocol defining the read-only interface for the Task Registry. Downstream components type-annotate their dependency as TaskRegistryProtocol, enabling test doubles (e.g. simple dict-backed stubs) without inheritance from the concrete TaskRegistry class. Methods: get_task(name: str) -> TaskConfig, __contains__(name: str) -> bool, task_names -> frozenset[str], __len__() -> int.

types.name: TaskNotFoundError

fields.name: task_name
fields.description: The task name that was requested but not found.

fields.name: available_tasks
fields.description: Sorted list of task names that are available in the registry, for diagnostic messages.

types.description: Domain exception raised when a task name lookup fails in the registry. Contains the requested task name and the set of available task names for diagnostic purposes. Inherits from Exception (not KeyError) to distinguish domain errors from programming errors.

types.name: TaskConfigList
types.description: A list of TaskConfig objects, used as the input to TaskRegistry construction from parsed YAML.

functions.name: TaskRegistry.__init__
functions.description: Construct a TaskRegistry from a list of TaskConfig objects. Validates all tasks, detects duplicate names, builds the internal immutable mapping. This is the only way to create a TaskRegistry — it is frozen after construction. Typically called by config_loader after parsing apprentice.yaml.

inputs.name: task_list
inputs.description: List of fully validated TaskConfig objects parsed from the 'tasks' section of apprentice.yaml. Must contain at least one task. All task names must be unique.

validators.error_message: At least one task must be configured.

error_cases.name: duplicate_task_names
error_cases.condition: Two or more TaskConfig objects in task_list share the same name

error_data.detail: Pydantic ValidationError identifying the duplicate task name(s). Message format: 'Duplicate task name(s) found: {names}'
Pydantic ValidationError: 'At least one task must be configured.'

error_cases.name: invalid_task_config
error_cases.condition: Any TaskConfig in task_list fails Pydantic validation (invalid field values, failed cross-field validators)

error_data.detail: Pydantic ValidationError with details about which TaskConfig field(s) failed validation and why

preconditions: task_list is a non-empty list of TaskConfig objects
Each TaskConfig in task_list has already passed its own field-level and model-level validation (schema structure, template placeholders, match_fields cross-referencing, threshold ordering)
All TaskConfig objects have been deserialized from a valid YAML config source
postconditions: Returned TaskRegistry is frozen — no mutations possible after construction
registry.tasks contains exactly one entry per input TaskConfig, keyed by TaskConfig.name
len(registry) == len(task_list)
For every tc in task_list: tc.name in registry and registry.get_task(tc.name) == tc
registry.task_names == frozenset(tc.name for tc in task_list)

structured_side_effects.description: Pure construction — no I/O, no logging, no file access. All validation is in-memory.

functions.name: get_task
functions.description: Look up a task configuration by its unique name. Returns the frozen TaskConfig for the given task name. Raises TaskNotFoundError if the name is not in the registry.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The task name to look up. Must be a non-empty string.

validators.error_message: Task name must not be empty.

error_cases.name: task_not_found
error_cases.condition: name is not a key in the registry's internal tasks mapping

error_data.task_name: The requested task name that was not found
error_data.available_tasks: Sorted list of all registered task names for diagnostic output

preconditions: The TaskRegistry has been successfully constructed (all startup validation passed)
postconditions: Returned TaskConfig has config.name == name
Returned TaskConfig is the same object stored at construction time (identity equality due to frozen model)
The registry is not modified by this call

structured_side_effects.description: Pure read-only lookup — no side effects.

functions.name: __contains__
functions.description: Check whether a task name exists in the registry. Supports the 'in' operator: `'my_task' in registry`. Returns True if the task name is registered, False otherwise.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The task name to check for membership.

preconditions: The TaskRegistry has been successfully constructed
postconditions: Returns True if and only if name is a key in the internal tasks mapping
The registry is not modified by this call

functions.name: task_names
functions.description: Property returning the frozenset of all registered task names. Useful for diagnostics, logging, and iteration. Returns an immutable set — callers cannot modify the registry through this property.
preconditions: The TaskRegistry has been successfully constructed
postconditions: Returned frozenset contains exactly the task names that were provided at construction time
len(returned) == len(registry)
For every name in returned: registry.get_task(name) succeeds
The registry is not modified by this call

functions.name: __len__
functions.description: Return the number of tasks in the registry. Supports the len() builtin: `len(registry)`.
preconditions: The TaskRegistry has been successfully constructed
postconditions: Returned value == number of TaskConfig objects provided at construction time
Returned value >= 1 (since construction requires at least one task)
Returned value == len(registry.task_names)

functions.name: TaskConfig.validate_match_fields_against_output_schema
functions.description: Pydantic @model_validator(mode='after') on TaskConfig that checks every entry in match_fields is a key in output_schema['properties']. Runs automatically during TaskConfig construction. Ensures evaluator can actually find the fields it needs in the task output.

inputs.name: self
inputs.description: The TaskConfig instance being validated after all field-level validation has passed.

error_cases.name: match_field_not_in_output_schema
error_cases.condition: One or more entries in match_fields are not keys in output_schema['properties']

error_data.detail: Pydantic ValidationError: 'match_fields references unknown output_schema properties: {missing_fields}. Available properties: {available_fields}'

preconditions: All field-level validators on TaskConfig have passed
output_schema has 'properties' key (enforced by field validator)
match_fields is a non-empty list of strings (enforced by field validator)
postconditions: Every string in match_fields is a key in output_schema['properties']
Returns self unchanged if validation passes

functions.name: TaskConfig.validate_prompt_template_against_input_schema
functions.description: Pydantic @model_validator(mode='after') on TaskConfig that extracts all {placeholder} names from prompt_template using string.Formatter and verifies each one is a key in input_schema['properties']. Runs automatically during TaskConfig construction.

inputs.name: self
inputs.description: The TaskConfig instance being validated after all field-level validation has passed.

error_cases.name: template_placeholder_not_in_input_schema
error_cases.condition: One or more placeholder names in prompt_template do not match keys in input_schema['properties']

error_data.detail: Pydantic ValidationError: 'prompt_template references unknown input_schema properties: {missing_placeholders}. Available properties: {available_fields}'

error_cases.name: malformed_prompt_template
error_cases.condition: prompt_template contains syntax errors that prevent placeholder extraction (e.g. unmatched braces)

error_data.detail: Pydantic ValidationError: 'prompt_template has invalid format string syntax: {parse_error}'

preconditions: All field-level validators on TaskConfig have passed
input_schema has 'properties' key (enforced by field validator)
prompt_template is a non-empty string (enforced by field validator)
postconditions: Every placeholder name extracted from prompt_template is a key in input_schema['properties']
Returns self unchanged if validation passes

functions.name: ConfidenceThresholds.validate_threshold_ordering
functions.description: Pydantic @model_validator(mode='after') on ConfidenceThresholds that verifies the logical ordering: emergency_threshold < coaching_trigger < phase2_to_phase3_correlation. Ensures the confidence score boundaries make semantic sense for phase transitions.

inputs.name: self
inputs.description: The ConfidenceThresholds instance being validated after all field-level range validators have passed.

error_data.detail: Pydantic ValidationError: 'Confidence thresholds must satisfy: emergency_threshold ({e}) < coaching_trigger ({c}) < phase2_to_phase3_correlation ({p}). Got: {e}, {c}, {p}'

preconditions: All field-level range validators have passed
postconditions: emergency_threshold < coaching_trigger
coaching_trigger < phase2_to_phase3_correlation
Returns self unchanged if validation passes

invariants: The TaskRegistry is immutable after construction — no tasks can be added, removed, or modified at runtime
Every TaskConfig in the registry has a unique name
len(registry) >= 1 — a registry must contain at least one task
For every TaskConfig tc in the registry: all entries in tc.match_fields are keys in tc.output_schema['properties']
For every TaskConfig tc in the registry: all {placeholder} names in tc.prompt_template are keys in tc.input_schema['properties']
For every TaskConfig tc in the registry: tc.confidence_thresholds.emergency_threshold < tc.confidence_thresholds.coaching_trigger < tc.confidence_thresholds.phase2_to_phase3_correlation
registry.task_names returns a frozenset equal to the set of keys in registry.tasks
All Pydantic ValidationErrors from invalid config propagate at construction time — the registry never exists in an invalid state
TaskConfig models use extra='forbid' — unrecognized fields in YAML cause a ValidationError at parse time, preventing silent misconfiguration
The TaskRegistryProtocol can be satisfied by any object implementing get_task, __contains__, task_names, and __len__ — enabling lightweight test doubles
